news.title: Korean kicker Ryan Jung is turning World Cup dreams into NFL ambitions
news.lede: Ryan Jung, the United States' top 2028 kicking prospect, will bring a booming leg and pinpoint accuracy to Michigan football, and maybe to the NFL as well. In American football, kickers rarely get the glory. Ryan Jung is changing that. The 18-year-old Korean senior at Georgia's Milton High School has already earned himself a formidable nickname: “monster kicker.”

news.title: Langden Kitchen out for season with knee injury for Mizzou football
news.lede: Mizzou football suffered another blow from injury last weekend, as head coach Eli Drinkwitz announced at a news conference Tuesday that edge rusher Langden Kitchen underwent season-ending knee surgery. Kitchen had surgery Tuesday morning, according to Drinkwitz. He is expected to make a full recovery and has the option to return to the Tigers with his fifth and final year of eligibility. "We look forward to trying to work with (Kitchen) to get him back on our football team for next year," Drinkwitz said Tuesday.

news.title: McTominay reveals heart treatment two days before Scotland’s World Cup opener
news.lede: Midfielder was in hospital before Haiti match. ‘I had to get the shock on my heart,’ says McTominay. Scott McTominay has revealed he was in hospital under sedation to have a “shock on my heart” just 48 hours before Scotland began their World Cup campaign against Haiti in June. At the time McTominay’s absence from training was put down to a stomach complaint.

news.title: ‘Act of Desperation’—Lionel Messi Receives Rare Criticism From World Cup Winner
news.lede: It’s not often that someone is willing to criticize Lionel Messi. But Argentina legend Jorge Valdano has accused his compatriot of “desperation” in the 2026 World Cup final, which La Albiceleste lost in a bid to become men’s soccer’s first back-to-back champions in 64 years.Messi turned back the clock in North American during the summer, scoring six goals during the World Cup group stage alone—he celebrated his 39th birthday while it was happening.Further goals followed in surprisingly challenging knockout wins against Cabo Verde and Egypt , giving Messi eight for the tournament. He was briefly the World Cup’s all-time leading goalscorer, a record that was broken immediately by Kylian Mbappé.But the final against Spain was too much for Argentina . The 2022 champion became increasingly frustrated, with Enzo Fernández shown a red card in stoppage time of the regulation 90.

news.title: 'I had to get the shock on my heart!' - Scott McTominay reveals secret hospital dash and cardiac procedure before Scotland's World Cup opener
news.lede: Scott McTominay has shared a startling revelation regarding his health, admitting he required an emergency heart procedure just 48 hours before Scotland’s World Cup opener. The Napoli midfielder was rushed to the hospital under police escort shortly after the national team arrived in the United States for their tournament campaign. The secret hospital dash in Boston Scotland international McTominay has finally broken his silence on a medical emergency that nearly derailed his participation in the World Cup this past June. While the public was told at the time that the midfielder was suffering from a minor illness, the reality was far more serious.

news.title: Palestra: ‘Italy defeat against Bosnia still hurts, but we have to turn the page’
news.lede: Italy and Chelsea full-back Marco Palestra admits that the World Cup play-off final defeat against Bosnia and Herzegovina earlier this year ‘still hurts a lot’ and potentially ‘always will’, but says that it is now down to the players to turn the page and write a new chapter in the history books. Palestra was called up to the Italy national team squad for the first time since Roberto Mancini was reinstated as CT last week and is hoping to put past disappointments behind him heading into Nations League fixtures against France and Belgium later this week. The 21-year-old missed out on selection for the first international break of the season as he was recovering from a muscular injury he picked up with Chelsea just before the 2026-27 Premier League season got underway.

news.title: Scotland's McTominay reveals World Cup heart scare
news.lede: LONDON: Scotland midfielder Scott McTominay has revealed he had to have his heart shocked just two days before playing in his country's World Cup opener against Haiti.
